basic_info.description: Almost identical to top floor unit! Pics are of top floor unit. You will fall in love w/ this gem. Middle unit home-like full flat in the heart of Nob Hill. Incredible light-filled unit Approx 1700 sq ft. 3 bedrooms. Remodeled bath. Remodeled eat-in kitchen w lovely tree views.Formal gorgeous dining room w original China cabinets w lead glass. Beautiful hardwood throughout. Huge laundry room off of kitchen  w washer / dryer, cabinet. Walk to the organic, gourmet Le Beau market. Huntington Park. Children's playground included in park too. Grace Cathedral minutes away. A 10 min walk to Polk St shopping w/ the new Bi-Rite market. North Beach is a 10 min walk heading East..HOA fees to be determined.Don't miss this amazing home-like unit w all the bells and whistles. Tic agreement drawn up, disclosure link online
